text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 116 million markka median
forecast for health care equipment maker Instrumentarium's
January-April 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax
(FIM million)
Median 116
Mean 112
Lowest 73
Highest 130
(Forecasts by eight analysts).
Instrumentarium's results are due on June 5 at 0830/0530
GMT.
In January-April 1996, Instrumentarium posted a profit of
110 million markka.
The median of five analysts' forecasts for Instrumentarium's
full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 340 million
markka (mean 331 million) in a 310-348 million markka range.
In 1996, Instrumentarium's profit was 273 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli
Securities, Merita Securities and Opstock Securities.
